author: JulianZN2003
body: I was banned from avicus a few months ago in November. I was banned for saying delete system32. There was also another person named liamjulian who is my brother and he was also banned because he was saying the same thing. I was then banned temporarily. And then when he saw my brother playing and also he had said delete system32, he assumed that this was an alternate account which I assure you it was not. I used to share this account with him for years but I wanted my own. I dont even play on that account anymore, and my brother was using it at the time so this was not ban evasion. So he then banned my brother pemanently and my ban was escalated into a permanent ban. So  It was not a ban evasion, just my brother. So we are both VERY sorry. On that old account we played on avicus since it was called it thewallsmc, and it was still to this day our favorite server. We promise we will never do anything like that again. So please unban us, or at least lower the ban to a month or more or less since that was what I was supposed to get before this whole misconcecption about a ban evasion happend. We are so sorry :( Please please please unban us, we will never do it again. Thank you for reading this.

title: Unban appeal

replies.author: JulianZN2003
replies.body: Edit: Also I just looked at the punishment again and it says for 'hacking minecraft' I really have no idea why they would think I was hacking. No one was saying I was hacking, and I wasnt. So yea I never hacked but sorry about whatever may have made the mods though I was.

replies.body:
Hello,

Since you have been banned for a decent amount of time, I will be appealing your infraction. However, if you are banned again, you will NOT have the chance to appeal again. Remember to read the rules (http://avicus.net/rules), and welcome back.
 
Regards,
PeachyYas | Senior Moderator
